messages:
marie-support: FYI customer SageMetrics can't process invoices — they uploaded PO PO-998 but billing rejects it (payee mismatch). They're asking for Net 60. Also saw a card decline on the most recent auto-charge.
kevin-csm: Customer says Net 60 is mandatory for their pilot budget cycle. They attached PO PDF and said VAT is on file.
marie-support: Repro steps i ran: 1) Invoices UI -> Attach PO -> error 'PO does not match payee name' 2) Tried /billing apply-po PO-998 -> 403 forbidden 3) Manual charge attempt returned card_decline. Screenshot: (uploaded). Invoice id INV-2026-019.
oscar-finance: Quick note on policy: Net >30 requires credit approval. I don't see a completed credit app for SageMetrics. We also validate VAT/tax docs for non-US payees.
june-accounting: Their VAT number in the PO doesn't match the registered country. We need a VAT certificate or corrected PO. Until docs are correct, automated invoicing will fail tax validation.
marie-support: Customer is asking for a temporary unblock — they want to run their pilot and will provide backup card if we need it. They prefer not to have the pilot delayed.
oscar-finance: Options: 1) provisional Net60 with a reserve (e.g., 20% first invoice hold) + credit check 2) require card on file as fallback 3) deny Net60 until paperwork is complete. Need exec signoff for provisional terms. Tagging @lena-cfo. :warning:
marie-support: @lena-cfo ping — can finance approve a provisional Net60 for pilot? Customer needs immediate unblock.
billing-bot: Payment attempt for INV-2026-019 failed: card_decline (insufficient_funds). Retry scheduled in 24h.
lena-cfo: We can approve Net60 up to $10k after a basic credit check and receiving signed PO + VAT cert. Condition: 20% reserve on first invoice and CC on file as secondary. Finance will issue a provisional approval email. :white_check_mark:
oscar-finance: I'll draft the approval email and workflows to mark the account for manual billing with provisional terms. Please collect: signed PO, VAT cert (if non-US), and a completed credit form.
marie-support: Got it — I'll send checklist to customer and request the CC as backup. ETA to customer?
oscar-finance: I will send an approval template and next steps in DM. Once docs are uploaded to billing portal and credit check passes, finance will flip the account to Net60. Marking thread as escalated -> pending-docs.
marie-support: Thanks all — flagging support ticket #SUP-4981 as blocked-by-finance and moving to 'escalated'. I'll update once customer returns docs. :spiral_calendar:
